# TRL-VAR-0011: Variable group is not authorized

- Severity: error
- Exit class: error
- Area: VAR
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active

## Remediation

Authorize the pipeline to use the variable group.

## Example

```json
{"code": "TRL-VAR-0011", "severity": "error", "params": {"group": "<group>"}}
```
